subject.title: Add backup/restore utility for config, cron jobs, and session history

question: What first-party backup/restore scope and safety model should OpenClaw support natively for config, cron jobs, sessions, credentials, and optional cloud storage?
rationale: The code path can be implemented in several incompatible ways, and the choice affects secret handling, destructive restore behavior, config/schema migration, session data retention, and whether optional cloud/encryption scheduling belongs in core or plugins.

options.title: Approve a scoped native restore design
options.body: Define local archive restore/import first with dry-run, manifest validation, safe extraction, overwrite policy, doctor integration, and explicit cron/session component semantics before any code PR.

options.title: Keep core create/verify plus plugin workflows
options.body: Leave cloud sync, scheduling, encryption, and broad migration to ClawHub/plugin packages while documenting the supported manual restore path and missing core APIs.

options.title: Defer the native lifecycle
options.body: Keep this umbrella open but block implementation until narrower session-history, per-agent restore, and docs follow-ups settle enough constraints to reduce the design surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped native restore design
recommendation.body: Define local archive restore/import first with dry-run, manifest validation, safe extraction, overwrite policy, doctor integration, and explicit cron/session component semantics before any code PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest maintainer-side review kept the umbrella open and routed it through product/security scope decisions, making steipete the best available decision owner from the observed history.
